title: lobularia maritima
intro: Lobularia maritima, commonly known as Sweet Alyssum, is a small, annual flowering plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat anxiety and insomnia, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Lobularia maritima include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Sweet Alyssum have been found to possess calming and sedative effects, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality.
